# New World Encyclopedia

> > A comprehensive online encyclopedia providing authoritative articles on diverse topics from linguistics and medicine to geology and theology, with community feedback integration.

New World Encyclopedia is a collaborative knowledge platform that combines expert-written encyclopedia articles with user feedback and discussion capabilities. The site covers a wide range of subjects including language, science, geography, and religious history, encouraging community engagement through structured feedback pages for each article.

## Key Topics

- Encyclopedia articles
- User feedback and discussion
- Linguistics and grammar
- Medical and health sciences
- Earth sciences and geology
- Geography and continents
- Religious history and theology
- Community contributions
- Article commentary
- Knowledge collaboration
- RSS syndication
- Educational resources

## Community Feedback & Discussion

- [Adjective Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/adjective/): User feedback and discussion page for the Adjective encyclopedia article
- [Allergy Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/allergy/): User feedback and discussion page for the Allergy encyclopedia article
- [Geology Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/geology/): User feedback and discussion page for the Geology encyclopedia article
- [Continent Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/continent/): User feedback and discussion page for the Continent encyclopedia article
- [Eutyches Feedback](https://www.newworldencyclopedia.org/feedback/eutyches/): User feedback and discussion page for the Eutyches encyclopedia article
